title: The highest-priority interventions cluster in high-stress districts where water pressure coincides with weaker productivity or market access

children.title: Priority sits in the overlap of **water stress** and **weaker farm economics**
children.subtitle: Positioning districts on two system axes isolates where targeted productivity, water, and market interventions create the strongest return

content.text: **Intervene first** = districts with high water stress plus weaker productivity or market links.
This placement adds a targeting lens to earlier district, irrigation, yield, and market slides by showing where constraints overlap rather than where each appears alone.

children.takeaway: Districts in the bottom-right quadrant merit first-call intervention because water risk and weaker income conversion compound.
